raw_content.initial_message: Hi, I just noticed I was charged twice for my monthly subscription this month. I see two charges of $29.99 on my credit card dated January 15th. Can you help me with this?
raw_content.context: Customer has been subscribed for 8 months. This is a legitimate duplicate charge due to a system glitch. Refund is authorized per policy.

learning_objectives: Learn to verify account information professionally
correct_sop_steps: Thank the customer for bringing this to attention
Verify the account using last 4 digits of card or email
Confirm you can see the duplicate charge in the system
Apologize for the inconvenience caused by the error
Provide timeline for refund to appear (3-5 business days)
Offer any goodwill gesture (e.g., one week free extension)
common_mistakes: Not verifying the account before discussing details
Making the customer wait while 'checking with supervisor' for obvious errors
Not apologizing for the company's error

bonus_points: Proactive assurance this won't happen again

sticky_notes: EASY WIN: This is a straightforward case. Focus on efficiency and warmth.
TIP: Always verify before discussing account specifics (privacy)
BONUS: Offering a small goodwill gesture builds loyalty

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will be satisfied with just the refund and timeline, but delighted if offered goodwill gesture
escalation_triggers: Being asked to repeat information multiple times
